_comment: CLUSTER 2 -- A SHIVAN GORGE ON THE BATTLEFIELD STARVES THE BLINK LOOP TO DEATH.
Rule GORGE fires (loop assembled + Shivan Gorge in play + red producible off Fertile Ground)
and the plan promises `blink Cloud of Faeries x20`. The apply produces exactly ONE event:
hist [damage] Shivan Gorge deals 1 to the opponent
Zero blinks. Opponent 20 -> 19. The go-off the button sold never happened.
ISOLATED BY REMOVING ONE PERMANENT (test/combo_off_sweep.py, synthetic family E):
this board                                   ->  0 blinks, 1 ping, NO WIN
+ a second {C} source (Adarkar Wastes)       ->  0 blinks, 1 ping, NO WIN
+ two more {C} sources                       ->  2 blinks, 1 ping, NO WIN
Emiel instead of Displacer (no {C} pip)      ->  0 blinks, 1 ping, NO WIN
Peregrine Drake instead of Cloud (5 untaps)  ->  0 blinks, 1 ping, NO WIN
SHIVAN GORGE REMOVED, Infiltrator deployed   -> 25 blinks
The last row is the finding: the identical loop runs twenty-five times once the damage sink
is off the board, and zero times with it on. It is not a colour problem and not an untap-
count problem -- it is the sink SPEND.
MECHANISM. ApplyBlinkLoop fires the damage sink before it pays the activation, deliberately
(SpellEffects.h: 'ORDER MATTERS. The sink fires BEFORE the tap-ahead: the tap-ahead would
otherwise tap the Gorge for its one {C} ...'):
if (cash_sinks) { SpendSurplusOnDamageSinks(state, controller, c, pay); }
if (untaps > 0) { EtbUntapTapAheadIntoFloat(...); }
if (!pay(c))    { break; }          <-- k == 0, done == 0
SpendSurplusOnDamageSinks does guard itself -- 'Never spend the loop's entry price: only fire
if the board could still pay BOTH this ability and the next iteration' -- but the guard is a
CanPay PROJECTION over a pooled AvailableManaPool:
ManaPool have = AvailableManaPool(state, nullptr);
have.AddPool(state.floating_mana);
if (!have.CanPay(AddManaCosts(c, keep_payable))) { continue; }
and a projection that says the two costs are jointly payable does not make the REAL payment
leave the blink payable: the Gorge's {2}{R} is paid first, from whatever the payer picks, and
it taps the Gorge itself plus the Fertile-Ground'd land -- two of the board's three {C}-capable
sources -- before the {2}{C} is ever attempted. The repo's own 'generic pays from SURPLUS'
doctrine is the rule being broken: the sink's generic half is paid out of scarce sources the
pending activation has a pip on.
SEVERITY. This does not only cost the GORGE path. Any board that happens to hold a Shivan
Gorge takes it, whichever rule offered the button.
EXPECTED TO FAIL until the fix lands.
